verdict_reason: Solid scoping/tombstone/pagination coverage, but the hand-copied update path leaves four of nine fields unasserted (phone unasserted anywhere in the suite) and the delete-idempotency test cannot fail if the guard is removed.

todos.issue: update() hand-copies nine request fields with no MapStruct @MappingTarget (so no unmappedTargetPolicy=ERROR compile guard as on create), but this test asserts only name, addressLine1, townOrCity, postcode and email — addressLine2, county, countryCode and phone are unasserted; phone is asserted nowhere on the PUT path in any unit or integration test, so deleting existing.setPhone(request.phone()) leaves the whole suite green
todos.fix: Assert all nine copied fields on the update test (or switch update() to an @MappingTarget mapper so the compile guard covers it); at minimum add assertThat(updated.getPhone()).isEqualTo("+44 1738 111222"), plus countryCode, addressLine2 and county

todos.issue: deleteOfAnAlreadyDeletedTombstoneIsIdempotentAndLeavesTheTombstoneUntouched does not actually cover the early-return guard in delete(): repository.save is not stubbed here, so if the 'if status == DELETED return' branch were deleted the mock save() would be a silent no-op and both assertions still hold (status is already DELETED, and modifiedAt is only bumped by real Spring Data auditing, which is mocked out)
todos.fix: Add verify(repository, never()).save(any()) so removing the idempotency guard fails the test

todos.issue: The modifiedAt 'bump' assertions at lines 183 and 237 assert the test's own thenAnswer stub, not production behaviour — the test sets saved.setModifiedAt(bumped) inside the mock and then asserts it; modifiedAt is a @LastModifiedDate field written by Spring Data auditing at the mocked repository boundary, so no unit test can observe the bump (same pattern for created.getId() at line 79)
todos.fix: Drop the modifiedAt assertions and the 'BumpsModifiedAt' clause from both test names — AddressUpdateIT.putBumpsModifiedAtAndPreservesCreatedAt already covers the bump against a real Mongo

todos.issue: The partialMatchRegex helper re-implements OperatorService.toPartialMatchRegex verbatim, so any change to the production regex moves both sides together and the eq() matcher still matches — the regex construction is effectively untested; relatedly the q.trim()/countryCode.trim() calls and the isBlank() branches in queryPage are never exercised (only null and already-trimmed non-blank values are passed)
todos.fix: Assert against a literal expected regex (eq(".*\\Qfarm\\E.*")) instead of a mirrored helper, and add cases for a whitespace-padded q, a blank q and a blank countryCode so the trim and isBlank branches are covered

todos.issue: The three search-dispatch tests (lines 336, 348, 359) make no assertion on the OperatorPageResponse that list() returns — their only 'assertion' is a fully-qualified org.mockito.Mockito.verify that restates the eq()-matched when(...) stub already made three lines earlier, which strict stubs would fail on anyway if the call did not match
todos.fix: Drop the redundant verify and assert on the returned response (e.g. items()/totalItems()); if a verify is kept, static-import it like every other Mockito member in this file

todos.issue: Test method names drop the documented {subject}_{shouldDoWhat} prefix and there are no // Given / // When / // Then blocks — the sibling OperatorMapperTest in the same package does follow it (toResponse_copiesEveryFieldFromTheEntity...), so the two files in one package read differently
todos.fix: Rename to the subject-prefixed form (create_stampsOrganisationIdFromTheHeader, update_appliesTheNewFieldValues, delete_isIdempotentForATombstone, list_...) and add the Given/When/Then blocks
